faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started
faq.q1: Are my invoices compliant with OHADA regulations?
faq.a1: Yes. Mandatory legal notices, sequential numbering, tax breakdowns and local currencies follow OHADA rules.
faq.q2: How do my clients pay me?
faq.a2: Straight into your own accounts! MyCashBill is a document tool, not a payment gateway. Your invoices show your payment details (Mobile Money, bank transfer, cash), and your clients pay you directly, with no commission.
faq.q3: Does the application work on mobile?
faq.a3: Yes! MyCashBill is a lightweight Progressive Web App designed mobile-first. You can add it directly to your home screen.
faq.q4: How does the free plan work and when should I go Pro?
faq.a4: The free plan requires no credit card and lets you create up to 10 invoices per month. As your business grows, you can upgrade to Pro (2,000 FCFA for 30 days, paid securely via Notch Pay by Mobile Money or card) to remove watermarks and get unlimited documents.
faq.q5: Can I send invoices directly via WhatsApp?
faq.a5: Absolutely. One tap opens a ready-to-send WhatsApp message with your invoice link and PDF attached.
